projects.title: Focus Today
projects.description: A civic-first mobile news platform with multilingual onboarding, live updates, and cross-device access.
projects.overview: Focus Today is a Flutter + Firebase product designed to publish verified civic content, emergency updates, and public-interest stories for regional audiences.
projects.challenge: The team needed a stable, multilingual, mobile-first publishing experience that remained simple for users while supporting high-volume content delivery.
projects.solution: We implemented a focused product architecture with OTP onboarding, structured feed/discovery patterns, configurable settings, and deployment-ready web/android access.

results.label: Localized onboarding and navigation flow
Story + PDF-ready content presentation
Firebase-backed update delivery model
Live web and Android distribution links

projects.title: TechMigos Hub
projects.description: A role-driven productivity app for secure company login, projects, tasks, discussion, settings, and team visibility.
projects.overview: TechMigos Hub is a mobile productivity platform that keeps secure login, dashboards, projects, tasks, discussions, files, settings, and role-based workspace controls in one clear team app.
projects.challenge: Teams needed a cleaner way to coordinate work without splitting ownership, updates, files, and permissions across disconnected tools.
projects.solution: We shaped TechMigos Hub around a mobile-first workflow with company login, project tracking, task states, task details, real-time discussion, file handling, settings, and role-aware administration.

results.label: Team progress and activity visible at a glance
Searchable project lists with progress tracking
Priority labels, status states, activity, and files
Discussion channels, mentions, and shared assets

projects.title: Notiva
projects.description: A voice-to-notes mobile app for capturing ideas, transcribing speech, organizing notes, and exporting content.
projects.overview: Notiva is a mobile note-taking product that turns voice capture into organized notes with transcription, simple review flows, settings, privacy controls, and export options.
projects.challenge: Users needed a faster way to capture spoken ideas and meetings while keeping notes searchable, editable, and easy to export.
projects.solution: We shaped a calm voice-notes experience with quick capture, instant transcription, recording review, note management, export settings, profile controls, and privacy-first app preferences.

results.label: Quick voice, meeting, and task note entry
Speech converted into editable note text
Notes, favorites, and continuation flows in one app
PDF, document, text, and backup-ready output paths

projects.title: SpendScanr
projects.description: A privacy-first personal finance app for tracking transactions, viewing spending analytics, exporting reports, and customizing settings.
projects.overview: SpendScanr is a mobile finance product that helps users log transactions, understand balances, review analytics, export reports, and control local-first privacy settings.
projects.challenge: Users needed a simple spending tracker that made money activity visible without adding heavy accounting workflows or confusing configuration.
projects.solution: We shaped a dark-mode-first finance experience with overview cards, searchable transactions, analytics export, category and currency settings, theme controls, and privacy-focused storage.

results.label: Balance, income, expenses, and recent activity
Searchable income and expense logging

projects.title: FocusFlow
projects.description: A calming focus assistant for daily planning, mood-aware preparation, deep work sessions, thought capture, and comfort controls.
projects.overview: FocusFlow is a mobile productivity product shaped around the real behavior of starting focused work, protecting deep-work time, and safely parking distractions.
projects.challenge: Most focus tools either feel too clinical or too busy. Users need help starting, staying, pausing, and recovering without the interface becoming another source of friction.
projects.solution: We shaped a calm session journey with daily planning, mood setup, guided preparation, a deep-work timer, thought dump capture, pause and end guardrails, and accessibility settings.

results.label: Clear focus goal, streak, and session agenda
Soft onboarding before each work session
Timer, pause, end, and extension controls
Reduced motion, font size, haptics, and backup settings

projects.title: Hastkala
projects.description: A full-featured Indian e-commerce artisan marketplace built to connect craftspeople directly with buyers. Deployed on Vercel with responsive desktop layouts.
projects.overview: Hastkala is a web-based artisan marketplace built to connect Indian craftspeople directly with customers. The platform celebrates handcrafted traditions — terracotta pottery, woven textiles, blue ceramics, lighting, and furniture — empowering over 2,000 artisans across 25+ states.
projects.challenge: Traditional artisan goods lacked a dignified digital storefront. Craftspeople had no discovery layer, buyers had no curated filter experience, and the platform needed to handle a 50+ product catalog with responsive design and intuitive navigation.
projects.solution: We built a Next.js storefront with category filters, price-range sliders, sort controls, star-rating system, discount badges, wishlist functionality, cart flow, vendor onboarding portal, and a structured About and Sell section — all deployed on Vercel.

results.label: Curated handcrafted catalog at launch
Empowered across 25+ Indian states
Category, price range, and sort controls
Production-deployed Next.js storefront

projects.timeline: Case-study product direction and layout strategy
projects.team: Next.js engineering, Web scraper design, and UX design
